content.caption: Line chart of average accuracy (%) for four models using no skill, EvoSkill, SkillOpt, or WikiSkill; WikiSkill is highest for every model.
content.description: A line chart with Accuracy (%) on the y-axis, gridlines at 30%, 45%, 60%, and 75%, and four models on the x-axis: Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash. It has four series: No skill (blue circles), EvoSkill (green squares), SkillOpt (orange triangles), and WikiSkill (yellow diamonds). Accuracy rises from left to right for every series. WikiSkill is the highest series at every model, and its lead grows for the larger models, reaching about 68% on Gemini 3.5 Flash. EvoSkill and SkillOpt sit in the middle and converge near 56% on Gemini. SkillOpt is slightly above EvoSkill only on Qwen3.5-4B. No skill is the lowest throughout, rising from about 26% to about 50%. No numeric data labels are printed, so all values below are estimated from the gridlines.
